subject.title: feat: add OpenClaw registry export bridge

question: Should this PR publish `buildOpenClawRegistryExport` as a stable root `clawhub-schema` bridge API now, or should the bridge remain internal/deferred until account and publisher feed contracts settle?
rationale: The implementation appears narrow and tested, but exporting a new package contract is a maintainer-owned product/API compatibility decision that automation cannot infer from code correctness alone.

options.title: Confirm and land the bridge API
options.body: Treat the exported helper and shape as the intended initial OpenClaw registry bridge contract and merge after ordinary maintainer review.

options.title: Keep it internal while the contract settles
options.body: Remove the root export or rename/scope the helper so downstream consumers do not rely on the shape yet.

options.title: Defer behind account feeds
options.body: Pause this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2948 settles the account/publisher feed shape it depends on conceptually.

recommendation.title: Confirm and land the bridge API
recommendation.body: Treat the exported helper and shape as the intended initial OpenClaw registry bridge contract and merge after ordinary maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on the catalog feed contract and `clawhub-schema` root export surface this PR extends.
